definitions.explanation: A person who has reached the age of majority.
The process or event of reaching adulthood.

examples.english: In Japan, you become an adult at 18.
On Coming of Age Day, many young people wear kimono and take photos.

notes:
{成人|せいじん} refers to adults and the process of becoming an adult.

CULTURAL NOTE:
{成人|せいじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (Coming of Age Day) is a national holiday in Japan held on the second Monday of January. Young people who turned 20 (or now 18, after the 2022 law change) during the year celebrate with ceremonies and often wear traditional clothing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{成人|せいじん}{式|しき}→成人式：05494_seijinshiki⟧ (coming-of-age ceremony)
- {成人|せいじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (Coming of Age Day)
- {成人|せいじん}⟦{向|む}け→向け：11011_muke⟧ (for adults)
- ⟦{成人|せいじん}{病|びょう}→成人病：17119_seijinbyou⟧ (adult diseases/lifestyle diseases)
- {成人|せいじん}⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧ (age of majority)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {成人|せいじん}: adult (legal/formal sense)
- ⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧: adult (general, everyday)
